body.value:
При version change на AGP 9.x не используй `buildTypes.versionCode` или
`buildTypes.versionName`: production остаётся в `defaultConfig`, debug app
переопределяется через `androidComponents.onVariants`, а maplib debug — через
`buildConfigField`. До handoff обязательно запусти из root
`tools\verify-apk-version-matrix.ps1`; имя APK не заменяет проверку `aapt`.

review.value: Complete AGP production/debug/library API constraints plus actual metadata matrix before a version-change handoff.

authority_limit.value: Path applicability is reviewed separately from the rule's textual triggers. Every source condition and heading remains attached; no automatic predicate or lifecycle inference. Stored commands and dates do not grant current execution, freshness or product acceptance. Existing instruction clients/checkers remain effective until measured cutover.
